rationale: cartservice shows the strongest non-symptom anomalies (socket +37.3% z=+7.46, mem +23.5% z=+4.70, cpu +61% z=+3.69), and frontend errors/sockets rise after the alert, but the service map lists no cartservice edges and the logs are empty.
